name: manifest-tree
description: A rendered Kubernetes manifest tree (the Argo CD plugin, a CI check, clearance register). An item is an object the change adds, changes or removes: type apiVersion/Kind, id namespace/name (name alone when cluster-scoped; a '/' or '~' inside a part is escaped as in a JSON pointer, ~1 and ~0). Objects listed as unchanged are in the tree, not the change, and are not items. The root is tree/1, the manifest-tree digest of the whole render, which the items do not determine. Its tiers are the core's Go (docs/gate.md, How a change is tiered).

itemTypes.description: Any Kubernetes object, as apiVersion/Kind (apps/v1/Deployment, v1/Secret).

digest.description: The verifier's object digest when it is not a bare sha256 (a sha256 is the item's hash).
